jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Developer Productivity
jobs.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It's built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet's largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

We are looking for a Director of Engineering to lead teams building AI-assisted engineering workflows. This role will partner with engineering leaders in infrastructure, developer productivity, security, product engineering, ads, machine learning, and senior technical leadership to make AI-native development safe, measurable, scalable, and effective across Reddit.

Reddit is entering a new era of software development. AI and agentic workflows are changing how code is planned, written, reviewed, tested, and shipped. Used well, these tools can help engineers move faster with higher confidence. Used poorly, they can increase complexity, review burden, operational risk, and cost. This role will help Reddit build the path for agentic development: flexible enough for teams to experiment, opinionated enough to protect quality, and measurable enough to prove whether AI is increasing delivered value rather than just activity. Just as importantly, this role will help bring teams along for that change, building trust in new workflows and helping Reddit evolve how we build software together.

Who We Are

The Developer Productivity organization builds the platforms, systems, and workflows that enable Reddit engineers to develop, test, review, deploy, and operate software safely and efficiently at scale. We work across infrastructure, AI tooling, developer environments, CI/CD, observability, code review, and software delivery systems to reduce friction, improve engineering effectiveness, and help teams focus on delivering impact for Reddit users.

As AI and agentic workflows reshape software development, Developer Productivity is helping define how Reddit builds software in the future. We are creating the foundations for AI-native engineering: scalable platforms for LLM access and evaluation, safe agent workflows, intelligent development environments, and measurement systems that help teams understand whether new tools are improving outcomes, not just increasing activity. We partner closely with engineering teams across Reddit to build paved paths that support experimentation while maintaining the quality, reliability, security, and operational standards required to run Reddit at scale.

What You'll Do

You will lead teams across Reddit's Developer Productivity and AI portfolio, spanning agent infrastructure, AI-assisted code review, developer environments, LLM governance, developer tooling, AI workflow measurement, and software delivery automation. You will partner deeply with engineering teams as a technical leader, balancing execution, organizational alignment, technical quality, and long-term platform strategy.

In this role, you will:

Lead and grow high-performing engineering teams focused on AI-native developer productivity, fostering a culture of technical excellence, ownership, inclusion, and continuous improvement.
Partner with Developer Productivity and Infrastructure leaders to translate strategy into scalable platforms and engineering roadmaps across code review, agent infrastructure, self-service LLM access, evaluation and observability systems, development environments, and safe agent workflows across the software development lifecycle.
Define and evolve the operating model for AI-native software development, including paved paths, platform adoption strategies, governance models, and engineering standards that enable safe and effective experimentation at scale.
Drive alignment across infrastructure, developer experience, reliability, security, compliance, product engineering, machine learning, and executive stakeholders. You will influence across organizations and create clarity across teams with different priorities and incentives.
Build engineering systems and organizational processes that help teams move from experimentation to durable adoption of AI-assisted workflows while maintaining quality, reliability, and operational safety.
Develop communication and enablement mechanisms that bring engineers and leaders along for the journey, including technical strategy reviews, working groups, training, documentation, rollout plans, and clear narratives that connect workflow change to business and engineering outcomes.
Build and operationalize measurement systems that distinguish real productivity from vanity metrics. Partner with engineering and data teams to define metrics such as design-to-test time, test-to-launch time, review turnaround, change failure rate, time to restore service, AI-authored code quality, AI-assisted pull request load, migration throughput, and developer satisfaction.
Drive AI governance and platform adoption in a way that preserves engineering creativity while ensuring security, cost management, privacy, compliance, and operational safety are built into the development lifecycle.
Use technical judgment to challenge assumptions, identify systemic risks, guide architectural tradeoffs, and help teams make pragmatic decisions across AI tooling, CI/CD, code review, deploy automation, developer environments, and production reliability.
Partner with senior engineering leadership on organizational planning, technical investment strategy, hiring, career development, and long-term platform evolution.

Who You Are

You have 14+ years of experience across software engineering, engineering management, infrastructure, developer tools, platform engineering, AI tooling, or related technical domains, including experience leading engineering teams.
You have managed high-performing engineering teams delivering large-scale technical platforms or infrastructure with executive visibility and cross-functional dependencies. You are comfortable operating with senior leaders while still engaging deeply in technical and operational details.
You have deep fluency in developer productivity systems: CI/CD, code review, testing, deployment, observability, developer environments, internal platforms, or AI-assisted development workflows.
You understand AI and LLM-enabled software development beyond personal productivity. You can reason about agent workflows, governance, evals, telemetry, code quality, review burden, cost controls, and operational risk.
You are highly data-driven, but skeptical of shallow metrics. You know how to build measurement systems that connect workflow improvements to business and engineering outcomes.
You are an exceptional cross-functional leader and communicator. You bring people together, create clarity across organizations, build trust across functions, and translate complex technical and organizational change into clear narratives for engineers, managers, executives, and cross-functional partners.
You have led meaningful organizational change, not just technical delivery. You know how to shift behavior across teams by listening to concerns, building confidence, and making the desired path easier and more valuable than the status quo.
You care deeply about engineering quality, operational excellence, and developer experience, and you know how to balance speed with long-term maintainability and reliability.
You get things done. You are not satisfied with status reporting, process theater, or activity metrics. You deliver outcomes and help teams understand the difference between motion and impact.
You are pragmatic and iterative. You can introduce structure without slowing teams down, and you know when a paved path should be adopted through value rather than enforcement.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience leading developer productivity, platform engineering, infrastructure modernization, or AI tooling teams at large scale.
Experience with LLM platforms, AI-assisted development tools, agentic workflows, or AI governance in an enterprise engineering environment.
Experience building internal platforms or developer tools where success depends on trust, usability, reliability, and measurable value.
Experience leading organizational transformation, platform adoption, or engineering workflow modernization initiatives across large engineering organizations.
Familiarity with engineering productivity frameworks such as DORA, SPACE, or similar multi-dimensional measurement approaches.
Experience working in fast-moving environments where technical strategy, organizational design, and execution mechanisms are evolving at the same time.

Benefits:

401k with Employer Match
Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support
Family Planning Support

South Gate, CA | On-site

Opportunity Summary

Join an established aerospace and defense manufacturer entering an exciting period of growth, modernization, and operational expansion. The company produces high-precision machined components and engineered manufacturing solutions supporting some of the industry's most demanding aerospace and defense programs. With strong business momentum and continued investment in engineering, automation, and manufacturing technology, this is an opportunity to help shape the next generation of the organization. As Director of Engineering, you will lead the engineering organization responsible for manufacturing engineering, CNC programming, technical proposal support, process development, tooling strategy, and new product introduction. Working directly with executive leadership, you will drive both day-to-day engineering execution and long-term strategic initiatives including manufacturing technology investments, automation, capital planning, and organizational development. This role is designed for an experienced engineering leader who wants to expand beyond functional management into executive leadership. The successful candidate will play a key role in the company's long-term succession strategy, with the opportunity to assume broader operational and executive responsibilities as the business continues to grow.

About Us

We are a well-established aerospace and defense manufacturer specializing in precision machining, advanced manufacturing, and production of complex hardware for highly regulated industries. Our business combines decades of manufacturing expertise with continued investments in automation, engineering talent, and modern production technologies to support long-term customer partnerships and sustained growth. As our manufacturing capabilities continue to expand, we are building the next generation of leadership that will guide the business through its next phase of growth, operational excellence, and technology adoption.

Lead, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary engineering organization including manufacturing engineers, CNC programmers, tooling engineers, NPI engineers, and technical sales engineers.

Evaluate emerging manufacturing technologies and lead implementation where they improve quality, throughput, efficiency, or profitability.

Serve as a strategic leader helping modernize manufacturing capabilities while preparing the organization for continued growth.

Qualifications

8+ years of engineering experience within advanced manufacturing.
3+ years leading engineering teams or technical organizations.
Strong knowledge of CNC machining, precision manufacturing, tooling, manufacturing processes, and production operations.

Master's degree in Engineering, Engineering Management, or Business Administration.

Partiful's mission is to cultivate friendships through social events.

We believe events are the most effective way to meet new people and make friends. Our product helps you throw incredible events, starting with memorable party pages that make it easy to plan & communicate with guests — download the app to see how it works!

We're building new ways to streamline planning, connect meaningfully in the real world, and make connections between friends-of-friends. Our ultimate vision is to power everything you do in-person with your friends, eliminating the friction of bringing your most memorable experiences to life. You can read more about our mission in The Washington Post, The New York Times, The Wall Street Journal, The Atlantic, Wirecutter, and USA Today. Partiful was named Google’s Best App of 2024, a Finalist for Apple’s App Store Awards, and Apple’s App of the Day (awarded 4x). In 2025, we were named one of TIME's 100 Most Influential Companies, one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and named to Inc. Magazine's Best in Business List.

Our company is backed by top-tier investors including Andreessen Horowitz and Google Ventures, and advised by the founders of some of the most successful consumer social products ever made.

The Role

We’re looking for a Head of Engineering to build and lead a high-performing engineering org that can ship ambitious product outcomes with speed, quality, and accountability as we scale.

You’ll own the health, output, and growth
of the engineering team — making sure the right people are in the right roles, the management layer is strong, and recruiting, culture, and execution all reinforce each other. This is not
a “headcount first” role: you should be obsessed with motivating and getting maximum leverage out of the current team and be willing to make hard calls when needed. You set the pace by example
— willing to dive into the work, do what it takes during critical moments, and hold the bar high for yourself and the team.

What you’ll do

Build and lead a high-performing engineering organization that can ship ambitious product and infra work with speed, quality, and accountability
Partner closely with the CTO on technical strategy, architecture, and roadmap prioritization; balance short-term product goals with long-term scalability and reliability
Partner closely with the CEO & CTO to communicate company vision and strategy, ensuring the entire engineering team is highly motivated to achieve ambitious goals
Own engineering execution and deadlines: ensure every project has clear goals, scope, owner, and deadlines — and that they’re consistently hit
Introduce lightweight, effective systems for ownership, accountability, and visibility (planning, status, reviews) without weighing the team down in process

Define, roll out, and maintain a clear career ladder and performance framework for engineers and managers
Build a culture where high performers are energized — people feel real ownership, are recognized and rewarded for impact, and are motivated to do the best work of their careers here
Hold a high bar for performance: celebrate wins and exceptional outcomes; ensure underperformance is identified early and addressed directly, whether via coaching, role changes, or exits
Own engineering recruiting end-to-end with the CTO and People team: set the bar, refine the process, and personally help source, interview, and close top talent
Codify and enforce engineering culture and standards (speed, craftsmanship, ownership, resilience); make excellence the default via code review norms, postmortems, documentation, and technical design practices
Strengthen cross-functional collaboration with Product, Design, and Ops so engineering effort is tightly aligned to company goals
Establish and track key metrics for engineering velocity, quality, and recruiting pipeline health, and use them to guide decisions
Work "in the trenches" with the team: we're in the office 3 days a week, with occasional late nights to get the job done

What you’ll bring

10+ years of software engineering experience, with proven leadership of 15–40+ engineers in a fast-paced startup or high-growth environment
Direct experience building and scaling an engineering org: hiring, org design, management systems, and performance management
A track record of driving operational excellence in engineering — predictable delivery, clear ownership, and high-quality output
Strong people leadership skills: you’ve hired, leveled, developed, and retained high-performing engineers and managers
Comfort making and executing on hard people decisions with clarity and empathy
Deep experience partnering with a founder/CTO and product leaders on roadmap, architecture, and tradeoffs
Strong recruiting instincts: you’re personally effective at sourcing, assessing, and closing top talent
Clear and concise communication; you create alignment, set context, motivate teams, and make decisions in the face of ambiguity
You’re energized by high-intensity, hands-on building — you’re willing to roll up your sleeves, live close to the work, and model the pace and standards you expect from the team

Background in consumer or highly product-centric engineering
Experience managing both product and infra/platform teams
Experience scaling teams in hybrid or in-office environments

Commuter benefits & contributions towards fitness / wellness (e.g., ClassPass, Citibike)

Parental leave
A front-row seat at an early, fast-growing company that cares deeply about product quality, culture, and building something people love

jobs.description:
The City of Port Angeles seeks a collaborative, strategic, and technically accomplished public works professional to serve as Deputy Director of Engineering Services and City Engineer.

Nature of the Work

Under the administrative direction of the Public Works & Utilities Director, the Deputy Director of
Engineering Services/City Engineer assists in planning, organizing, coordinating, and directing the
engineering services and operations of the Public Works & Utilities Department while serving as
the City’s designated City Engineer. This position provides executive leadership to a dedicated team
responsible for the City’s engineering related services and functions by overseeing the planning, design,
construction, and delivery of major public infrastructure projects.

The Deputy Director plays a key leadership role in advancing the City’s strategic priorities by directing
long-range planning for the Stormwater, Water, and Wastewater Utilities, managing complex capital
improvement programs, providing technical and policy guidance to City leadership, and ensuring
compliance with applicable local, state, and federal regulations. The position also serves as Acting Public
Works & Utilities Director in the Director’s absence.

Key Responsibilities:

Provide leadership and administrative oversight for the Engineering Services Division, including engineering, and related technical functions.
Assist the Public Works & Utilities Director in planning, organizing, and directing departmental operations, policies, strategic initiatives, and long range infrastructure planning.
Lead the planning, design, construction, and inspection of major public works and utility capital improvement projects.
Develop, administer, and monitor divisional operating and capital budgets, including oversight of the City’s Capital Improvement Program.
Serve as the City’s principal engineering advisor to the Public Works & Utilities Director, Deputy City Manager, City Manager, City Council, Utility Advisory Committee, and other public agencies on engineering, utility, and infrastructure matters.
Prepare and present reports, recommendations, technical analyses, and presentations to City leadership, elected officials, advisory committees, and the public.
Ensure compliance with applicable local, state, and federal laws, regulations, engineering standards, and permitting requirements governing public works and utility operations.
Assist in developing ordinances, policies, standards, and procedures that support the effective delivery of engineering and utility services.
Supervise, mentor, and develop engineering staff while fostering a collaborative, customer-focused, and high-performing work environment.
Coordinate engineering activities with other City departments, outside agencies, consultants, contractors, and utility partners to ensure successful project delivery.
Serve as Acting Public Works & Utilities Director during the Director’s absence and perform other related duties as assigned.

Desirable Qualifications:

The successful candidate will possess a bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, environmental engineering, or a closely related engineering field from an accredited college or university. Registration as a Professional Engineer (PE) is required.

The ideal candidate will have progressively responsible management experience leading engineering, public works, or utility operations, preferably within a municipal or other public sector organization with
multiple utility systems. Experience overseeing engineering staff, capital improvement programs, resource management, permitting, and public infrastructure projects is highly desirable. Experience administering public works construction contracts and professional services agreements is also preferred. An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience that demonstrates the knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary to successfully perform the essential functions of the position may be considered.

The successful candidate must possess a valid Washington State driver’s license at the time of appointment or be able to obtain one within thirty (30) days of hire and maintain a driving record acceptable to the City’s Risk Manager.

Salary and Benefits:

$141,367-$168,976 annually
This position is also eligible for relocation reimbursement up to $10,000.

Other benefits include:
•Up to 3% deferred compensation employer contribution
13 paid holidays
Vacation and sick leave accrual
Medical insurance (12.5% employee-paid premium)
Employer contribution to Health Savings Account
Dental and Vision insurance
Health Care Offset
Employee Assistance Program
Employer-paid life insurance ($50,000 plan)
Long-term disability
Washington State Retirement System (PERS)
40 hours of management leave annually

Why Port Angeles Is For You: 

Located on the northern edge of the Olympic Peninsula along the shores of the Strait of Juan de Fuca, the City of Port Angeles offers a rare combination of dramatic natural beauty and a vibrant, welcoming community. The surrounding peninsula is renowned for its extraordinary diversity—lush temperate rainforests, rugged mountain ranges, pristine rivers, and expansive ocean beaches all within easy reach.

Port Angeles is a modern coastal city with a rich and diverse history, including a strong and visible Native American presence that continues to shape the area’s culture and community life. Residents enjoy a wide array of cultural offerings, from festivals and arts events to music, recreation, and local sporting activities. Educational opportunities are excellent, with highly regarded public schools and Peninsula College offering both two- and four-year degree programs. Outdoor recreation is a defining feature of life in Port Angeles.
Nearby amenities include hot springs, beaches, rivers, and parks, as well as Olympic National Park and the Olympic Discovery Trail— one of the longest continuous trail systems in the United States. The city also serves as an international gateway, with ferry service to Victoria.

Port Angeles benefits from a mild coastal climate, with typical daytime temperatures ranging from the 40s in winter to the 70s in summer, and average annual rainfall of less than 25 inches. To learn more about the community, visit www.cityofpa.us and www.visitportangeles.com.

How To Apply:

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Developer Productivity
jobs.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It's built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet's largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

We are looking for a Director of Engineering to lead teams building AI-assisted engineering workflows. This role will partner with engineering leaders in infrastructure, developer productivity, security, product engineering, ads, machine learning, and senior technical leadership to make AI-native development safe, measurable, scalable, and effective across Reddit.

Reddit is entering a new era of software development. AI and agentic workflows are changing how code is planned, written, reviewed, tested, and shipped. Used well, these tools can help engineers move faster with higher confidence. Used poorly, they can increase complexity, review burden, operational risk, and cost. This role will help Reddit build the path for agentic development: flexible enough for teams to experiment, opinionated enough to protect quality, and measurable enough to prove whether AI is increasing delivered value rather than just activity. Just as importantly, this role will help bring teams along for that change, building trust in new workflows and helping Reddit evolve how we build software together.

Who We Are

The Developer Productivity organization builds the platforms, systems, and workflows that enable Reddit engineers to develop, test, review, deploy, and operate software safely and efficiently at scale. We work across infrastructure, AI tooling, developer environments, CI/CD, observability, code review, and software delivery systems to reduce friction, improve engineering effectiveness, and help teams focus on delivering impact for Reddit users.

As AI and agentic workflows reshape software development, Developer Productivity is helping define how Reddit builds software in the future. We are creating the foundations for AI-native engineering: scalable platforms for LLM access and evaluation, safe agent workflows, intelligent development environments, and measurement systems that help teams understand whether new tools are improving outcomes, not just increasing activity. We partner closely with engineering teams across Reddit to build paved paths that support experimentation while maintaining the quality, reliability, security, and operational standards required to run Reddit at scale.

What You'll Do

You will lead teams across Reddit's Developer Productivity and AI portfolio, spanning agent infrastructure, AI-assisted code review, developer environments, LLM governance, developer tooling, AI workflow measurement, and software delivery automation. You will partner deeply with engineering teams as a technical leader, balancing execution, organizational alignment, technical quality, and long-term platform strategy.

In this role, you will:

Lead and grow high-performing engineering teams focused on AI-native developer productivity, fostering a culture of technical excellence, ownership, inclusion, and continuous improvement.
Partner with Developer Productivity and Infrastructure leaders to translate strategy into scalable platforms and engineering roadmaps across code review, agent infrastructure, self-service LLM access, evaluation and observability systems, development environments, and safe agent workflows across the software development lifecycle.
Define and evolve the operating model for AI-native software development, including paved paths, platform adoption strategies, governance models, and engineering standards that enable safe and effective experimentation at scale.
Drive alignment across infrastructure, developer experience, reliability, security, compliance, product engineering, machine learning, and executive stakeholders. You will influence across organizations and create clarity across teams with different priorities and incentives.
Build engineering systems and organizational processes that help teams move from experimentation to durable adoption of AI-assisted workflows while maintaining quality, reliability, and operational safety.
Develop communication and enablement mechanisms that bring engineers and leaders along for the journey, including technical strategy reviews, working groups, training, documentation, rollout plans, and clear narratives that connect workflow change to business and engineering outcomes.
Build and operationalize measurement systems that distinguish real productivity from vanity metrics. Partner with engineering and data teams to define metrics such as design-to-test time, test-to-launch time, review turnaround, change failure rate, time to restore service, AI-authored code quality, AI-assisted pull request load, migration throughput, and developer satisfaction.
Drive AI governance and platform adoption in a way that preserves engineering creativity while ensuring security, cost management, privacy, compliance, and operational safety are built into the development lifecycle.
Use technical judgment to challenge assumptions, identify systemic risks, guide architectural tradeoffs, and help teams make pragmatic decisions across AI tooling, CI/CD, code review, deploy automation, developer environments, and production reliability.
Partner with senior engineering leadership on organizational planning, technical investment strategy, hiring, career development, and long-term platform evolution.

Who You Are

You have 14+ years of experience across software engineering, engineering management, infrastructure, developer tools, platform engineering, AI tooling, or related technical domains, including experience leading engineering teams.
You have managed high-performing engineering teams delivering large-scale technical platforms or infrastructure with executive visibility and cross-functional dependencies. You are comfortable operating with senior leaders while still engaging deeply in technical and operational details.
You have deep fluency in developer productivity systems: CI/CD, code review, testing, deployment, observability, developer environments, internal platforms, or AI-assisted development workflows.
You understand AI and LLM-enabled software development beyond personal productivity. You can reason about agent workflows, governance, evals, telemetry, code quality, review burden, cost controls, and operational risk.
You are highly data-driven, but skeptical of shallow metrics. You know how to build measurement systems that connect workflow improvements to business and engineering outcomes.
You are an exceptional cross-functional leader and communicator. You bring people together, create clarity across organizations, build trust across functions, and translate complex technical and organizational change into clear narratives for engineers, managers, executives, and cross-functional partners.
You have led meaningful organizational change, not just technical delivery. You know how to shift behavior across teams by listening to concerns, building confidence, and making the desired path easier and more valuable than the status quo.
You care deeply about engineering quality, operational excellence, and developer experience, and you know how to balance speed with long-term maintainability and reliability.
You get things done. You are not satisfied with status reporting, process theater, or activity metrics. You deliver outcomes and help teams understand the difference between motion and impact.
You are pragmatic and iterative. You can introduce structure without slowing teams down, and you know when a paved path should be adopted through value rather than enforcement.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience leading developer productivity, platform engineering, infrastructure modernization, or AI tooling teams at large scale.
Experience with LLM platforms, AI-assisted development tools, agentic workflows, or AI governance in an enterprise engineering environment.
Experience building internal platforms or developer tools where success depends on trust, usability, reliability, and measurable value.
Experience leading organizational transformation, platform adoption, or engineering workflow modernization initiatives across large engineering organizations.

Over the last decade, software has transformed the digital world. But the physical world, where food is made, minerals are mined, goods are moved, and industries are run, remains far less intelligent, far less efficient, and far more constrained. We're changing that.

Atoms builds Physical AI — real-world robots for the industries that move civilization forward, starting with food, mining, and transport. jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
TAF Carbon has an exciting opportunity for someone passionate about engineering and sustainability and eager to be part of an innovative company that’s on a journey to transform the world’s materials.

We are seeking a Director of Engineering who has lived the journey from lab bench to production floor, to join our team working directly with the Director of Research and Development and the leadership team. You will lead our Process Scale-Up & Manufacturing effort, bridging between our world-class R&D scientists and the industrial manufacturing partners who will bring our carbon foam materials to commercial scale. This is a hands-on, technically deep leadership role for someone who finds equal satisfaction in rigorous process analysis and in building the systems and relationships that make manufacturing actually work. This role grows with the company. Near-term, you will be driving industrialization and process control. Over time, you will contribute to new product development from the process and tooling side, and to the early foundations of TAF Carbon's own manufacturing capabilities.

This role is part of the team that services the entire Endeavour ecosystem and contributes to the overall health and success of the organization.

The Director of Engineering needs to be agile, professional, and comfortable in a rapidly changing environment. The right person is trustworthy with confidential information, highly organized, self-motivated, has excellent communication skills, can think strategically, and works equally as well independently as with a team. They are a born problem solver and highly self-motivated to identify and address engineering challenges.

TAF Carbon is highly selective about the people we bring on board because our ecosystem depends on it. Change happens quickly here, and we must maintain a strong team of honest, communicative, collaborative, open-minded, strategic, reliable, and driven team members. We seek ultra-creative performers with self-awareness, a sense of humility, and a hunger to make a positive impact in the world. Endeavour offers flexibility and endless growth opportunities to those who can harness their skills and talents and identify how and where to use them to add value. Our team is the heart of the ecosystem. We’re a diverse group of bright, passionate, dedicated people, working together to make a real difference. Are you ready to join the journey?

Key Responsibilities

Include But Are Not Limited To

Process Scale-Up & Industrialization

Lead the translation of laboratory and pilot-scale carbon foam processes into robust, reproducible industrial manufacturing operations to take our material through testing and certification, prototyping, and product commercial launch.
Hands-on engineering and problem solving in a fast-growing start-up environment.
Define and implement process control and improvement frameworks — including 6 Sigma, SPC and MSA — that establish and sustain process capability across manufacturing environments.
Drive continuous improvement in process efficiency, energy performance, heating uniformity, cost of goods and time to market.
Develop and evaluate innovative approaches to mold design, heating technology, and process configuration that enable scalable, high-throughput production.
Establish and maintain high engineering standards, including documentation, design review processes, and technical governance

Manufacturing Partner Development

Identify, qualify, and develop long-term technical relationships with external manufacturing partners.
Serve as TAF Carbon's primary technical interface with manufacturing operations, ensuring alignment on process requirements, quality standards, and scale-up milestones.
Collaborate with R&D teammates to translate research outcomes into manufacturable processes and clear manufacturing inputs, streamlined processes, to reduce time to market.

Team & Organization

Mentor and grow a high-performing engineering team, fostering a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and pragmatic problem-solving.
Support project planning, prioritization, and budgeting in alignment with organizational goals and timelines.
Partner with leadership on strategic product and manufacturing roadmaps across all phases of commercial development.
Model culture of demanding excellence, scientific rigor, problem solving and a daily irreverence to big company corporate culture.

Longer-Term

Lead engineering contributions to new product development and cost reduction from the process and tooling side.
Contribute to early planning and capability-building for TAF Carbon's future manufacturing assets.
Develop and maintain strong customer relationships, supporting tailored product solutions and long-term partnerships.

Skills & Requirements

Education / Experience

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical or Chemical Engineering (or related field).
10+ years of progressive engineering experience in industry with 3+ years in a leadership or management role.
Demonstrated track record taking a material or chemical process from lab or pilot scale to industrial production — you have done this, not just supported it.
Deep working knowledge of foamed materials and the industrial processes used to make them: polymer foams, carbon foams, ceramic foams, or closely analogous materials.
Hands-on experience with mold design and molding processes, including thermal analysis, dead mass minimization, and scale-up.
Experience designing or improving industrial heating systems — convective, or other non-conventional approaches are a strong plus.
Experience working with toll manufacturers or contract manufacturers as a technical owner, not just a customer.
Proven expertise in Statistical Process Control (SPC), Measurement System Analysis (MSA), and process capability (Cpk, Ppk) — you use these instinctively, not on request.
Expertise with Design of Experiments (DOE) for process optimization.
Experience with continuous or semi-continuous manufacturing line concepts (belt press, or equivalent) is a strong plus.
Experience with controlled atmosphere processing and/or high-temperature industrial environments preferred.
Experience in gas handling, exhaust treatment and waste heat collection and re-use is a plus.
Proven track record driving product qualification, regulatory certification and new product introduction.

Specific Skills / Abilities

You know the difference between a research result and a manufacturable process, and you say so when you see it.
Strong process and systems mindset — experience implementing design control, setting and meeting specifications, and moving product from lab to pilot to prototype to full manufacturing.
Skilled in partner engagement, technical presentations, and developing tailored engineering solutions.
Able to work at the bench and on the whiteboard for manufacturing line design the same week.
Excellent leadership, communication, and mentoring skills with a collaborative, hands-on approach.
Entrepreneurial drive: comfortable with ambiguity, fast iteration, and doing more with less.

Enjoy…

A fast-paced, entrepreneurial culture focused on innovation.

A flexible, autonomous work environment.

A culture of respect, learning, and excellence.

Experienced, highly talented experts as team peers.

Growth and travel opportunities.

A team of change-makers having a significant impact on people and the planet.

About TAF Carbon

TAF Carbon develops ultra high end carbon based materials that compete with “ordinary materials” in the construction market and beyond. Our team of passionate change-makers want to leave the world better than the way we found it and work towards a future of Better Materials Everywhere. TAF Carbon prides itself on hiring talented, highly motivated people because that’s what our mission requires. To work at TAF Carbon is to know that you are part of something special—something bigger than yourself.

Today, we’re deploying solutions that are game changing, scalable and profitable, taking on challenges based on the needs of our clients and partners and of local and global economies. At TAF Carbon we combine the best of what technology and the natural world can offer in developing a truly game changing material. Are you ready to #JoinTheJourney?

Who We Are

Samsung HME America (Healthcare and Medical Equipment) is Samsung’s U.S. medical imaging organization, delivering advanced diagnostic solutions across Ultrasound, Digital Radiography, and Computed Tomography. We lead nationwide sales, marketing, service, and distribution of Samsung’s imaging technologies, partnering with healthcare providers to strengthen diagnostic capabilities, streamline clinical workflows, and support better patient care. Samsung HME America also serves as the global manufacturing center for Samsung’s mobile Computed Tomography (mCT) business, leading the development of advanced CT systems used by healthcare providers worldwide.

Backed by Samsung Electronics’ global technology leadership, our teams work closely with clinicians to translate real-world challenges into innovative imaging solutions. Our culture combines a sense of urgency, customer focus, and clinical collaboration to advance the future of medical imaging.

The Director of Engineering is responsible for leading a cross-functional team in the development of new products and the continuous improvement of existing products for the Mobile Computed Tomography business. The Director of Engineering works closely with cross-functional teams, including Service, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Applications and Product Management, to deliver innovative, reliable, and cost-effective solutions to fulfill the company’s Market, Product & Technology strategy.

Description

AWS Open Data Analytics Engines is a suite of fully managed, high-performance analytics services built on popular open-source frameworks, enabling customers to process, analyze, and derive insights from massive datasets with speed, flexibility, and cost efficiency. Open Data Analytics Engines make it easy for organizations to run petabyte-scale analytics using familiar open-source tools without the operational burden of managing infrastructure.

AWS Open Data Analytics Engines encompasses services purpose-built for large-scale data processing, interactive querying, real-time streaming, and machine learning workloads. The platform leverages open-source engines such as Apache Spark, Presto/Trino, Apache Flink, and Apache Hive, delivering seamless integration with the broader AWS ecosystem. Compute and storage are decoupled, enabling elastic scaling, fine-grained cost optimization, and support for diverse data lake architectures.

As Director of Engineering for Open Data Analytics Engines, you will lead a group of top talent in advancing the strategy and technical roadmap for innovations in engine efficiency, query planning and optimization, features, and performance. You'll drive the design, development, and operation of next-generation open-source analytics services on AWS, shaping the future of how customers run large-scale queries in the cloud.

Key job responsibilities

Grow and lead a software development organization responsible for building key AWS analytics services based on open-source engines.

Drive the design, implementation, testing, and deployment of managed analytics services spanning batch processing, interactive queries, and real-time streaming.

Own the strategy and technical roadmap for innovations in engine efficiency, query planning and optimization, and performance — setting the direction for how AWS advances the state of the art in open-source analytics.

Draw from your deep and broad technical and management expertise to mentor senior engineers and managers, complete hands-on technical work, and provide leadership on complex technical issues, design tradeoffs, and feature and schedule prioritization.

Work with senior executives to develop business targets and resource requirements, influence technical and business strategy, hire talented engineers and managers, and conceive innovative new solutions for customers.

A day in the life

Leading the Open Data Analytics Engines team gives you the opportunity to:

Work on industry-defining products in the rapidly evolving open-source data analytics space

Solve challenging problems in query planning and optimization, distributed query execution, stream processing, resource scheduling, and performance at cloud scale

Build products that deliver the power of open-source analytics with the reliability, security, and ease-of-use customers expect from AWS

Work for a company that is a recognized leader in cloud computing

Be involved in the fast-growing cloud analytics and data lake market

Develop and execute a strategic roadmap for the future of open-source analytics on AWS

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science (or related field) or equivalent work experience

10+ years in the development of mission-critical system software, including work on distributed systems, large-scale data processing, or analytics platforms

5+ years managing engineering teams

5+ years partnering with sales, marketing, and customer success teams

Experience developing and deploying cloud-based analytics technology, particularly services built on open-source frameworks (Spark, Presto/Trino, Flink, Hive)

Deep knowledge of query planning and optimization, whether gained through distributed query engines or relational databases along with resource scheduling, data lake architectures, and performance tuning at petabyte scale

Experience operating services at global scale with stringent latency, throughput, and availability requirements

Advanced degree: Masters or PhD in Computer Science or Engineering, or MBA or similar business qualification

About Athena

Athena (athena.com) pairs world-class leaders with elite executive assistants. It’s where some of the most powerful partnerships in the world get built.

Our clients are founders, executives, and leaders whose ambition exceeds their time. Athena is the first company to build a human-in-the-loop executive support system, combining trained Executive Assistants with market-leading AI to help them stay organized, follow through on priorities, and operate at their highest level.

Athena is one of the largest companies in this category, with 3,000+ clients and over $100M in annual run rate. Our clients include Uber, Shopify, and Goldman Sachs.

We are fully global, working across time zones and cultures. Joining Athena means creating something that fundamentally changes how people live and work and brings extraordinary achievement within reach.

Who We’re Looking For

We’re looking for people who take their work seriously and want to get better at it.

You should be thoughtful in how you approach problems, willing to take ownership, and able to follow through without constant direction. You ask questions when something doesn’t make sense, and you care about getting the details right.

You should be comfortable working with people who have high expectations and limited time. That means being clear, responsive, and reliable.

We’re also looking for people who are interested in how this role is changing. The way work gets done is in flux between people, systems, and AI. We want people who are curious about that and willing to adapt as technology evolves.

You don’t need to know everything on day one, but you should be able to learn quickly and apply what you learn.

Role Overview

The Senior Engineering Manager, Platform will lead the team responsible for Athena's business-critical platform systems across sales, partnership operations, retention, Athena AI operations, billing, and internal workflow automation.

This leader will define technical direction, develop engineers and managers, and partner closely with Product, Operations, Data, Finance, Legal, Sales, and Athena AI. The role requires the judgment to balance near-term business needs with long-term platform architecture, reliability, and maintainability.

The team is building systems such as the Ops Platform, partnership case management and intervention workflows, AI-assisted document generation, onboarding and offboarding automation, shared identity and SSO, sales enablement tools, billing and referral integrations, and stronger monitoring and operational foundations.

Set platform strategy and technical direction: Define the architecture and roadmap for shared business platforms, workflow systems, integrations, APIs, permissions, and automation capabilities.
Drive execution across critical initiatives: Translate ambiguous business problems into clear technical plans, milestones, ownership, and measurable outcomes.
Partner cross-functionally: Work closely with Product, Operations, Sales, Finance, Legal, Data, and Athena AI to design practical systems that reflect real workflows, controls, and edge cases.
Build reusable systems: Reduce one-off solutions by creating common platform capabilities for workflow orchestration, case management, reporting, role-based access, document generation, and third-party integrations.
Improve engineering excellence: Strengthen design reviews, testing, release practices, monitoring, incident response, documentation, and production readiness.
Own operational reliability: Improve alerting coverage, reduce production issue resolution time, and ensure the team learns from incidents and recurring support patterns.
Measure impact: Ensure platform work is connected to business metrics such as sales conversion, workflow completion, intervention success, operational effort, retention, and system reliability.
Communicate clearly: Provide concise updates on progress, tradeoffs, risks, and decisions to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

Qualifications

Leadership experience: 8+ years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years managing engineering teams and at least 2 years leading senior engineers, managers, or multiple workstreams.
Technical depth: Strong background in backend, full-stack, platform, infrastructure, or enterprise application engineering, with the ability to guide architecture and make sound technical tradeoffs.
Platform experience: Experience building and operating business-critical platforms involving APIs, integrations, workflow orchestration, stateful business processes, permissions, and complex data models.
People management: Demonstrated success hiring, coaching, developing, and retaining strong engineers and managers, including effective performance and career management.
Execution: Track record of delivering complex, cross-functional programs from problem definition through launch, adoption, and iteration.
Product and business judgment: Ability to understand operational problems, challenge requirements constructively, prioritize based on impact, and connect engineering decisions to business outcomes.
Operational excellence: Experience improving reliability, observability, incident response, testing, release processes, and engineering productivity.
Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions, risks, and tradeoffs to senior stakeholders.
Adaptability: Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities, incomplete information, and high expectations.
Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Experience leading internal platforms, operations systems, CRM-adjacent products, case management, billing, or enterprise workflow products.
Experience with AI-powered products, LLM integrations, agent systems, or AI-assisted workflow automation.
Experience with authentication, authorization, SSO, role-based access control, and privacy-sensitive workflows.

Lead a team that owns production health in an on-call, continuous delivery environment, improving incident response, observability, and reliability over time.

In your first year:

Lead the software roadmap in close partnership with cross-functional stakeholders, balancing member experience, technical quality, operational reliability, and regulatory constraints across the platform.
Hire, coach, and develop engineers and emerging technical leaders, building a high-performance, high-accountability culture within a complex and high-ambiguity remit.

Who You Are

You are an experienced engineering leader who thrives at the intersection of consumer software, connected devices, and regulated product delivery, and you are comfortable operating in high-ambiguity, high-accountability environments.

Director, Head of Software Engineering

Job Description

HITT is seeking a Head of Software Engineering to build a modern, AI-native software engineering practice from the ground up. This is a senior leadership role for an engineering executive with a builder’s mindset: someone who has seen firsthand how agentic, AI-enabled development is changing the way software gets made — and who knows how to turn that shift into a durable advantage for one of the nation’s largest general contractors. They bring the vision, technical depth, and people leadership to define how software gets built at HITT as the firm scales.

Reporting to the Chief Information Officer, the Head of Software Engineering will establish HITT’s agentic engineering practice from scratch — setting the technical vision, standing up lean, agile product teams, and creating the standards, workflows, and culture that let small teams of AI-fluent engineers deliver high-quality software at a pace traditional development organizations cannot match. This leader understands that tools are only half the story: lasting change comes from people, and they will be as invested in recruiting and developing talent as in technology itself.

The Head of Software Engineering is accountable for the structure and growth of the engineering organization, the delivery of applications and platforms that serve HITT’s project teams and jobsites nationwide, and the development of a new generation of AI-enabled engineering talent — hiring builders who already work this way and training HITT’s existing developers in new methods. The role partners closely with senior leaders across the firm and serves as a visible champion for the responsible, high-leverage use of AI in how HITT builds.

Responsibilities

Agentic Engineering Practice

Design, launch, and lead HITT’s agentic engineering practice from the ground up, defining the operating model, team structure, and software development lifecycle for AI-enabled delivery
Establish standards, guardrails, and best practices for agentic development — including AI coding agents and assistants, prompt and context engineering, human-in-the-loop review, automated testing, and evaluation
Select, implement, and evolve the AI development toolchain (coding agents, LLM platforms, orchestration frameworks, and integrations), reassessing regularly as the landscape advances
Partner with the CIO on the enterprise technology, data, and AI roadmap, ensuring the engineering practice accelerates HITT’s broader digital transformation
Ensure the software the practice ships are reliable, fast, and usable in high-velocity, decentralized field environments with users of many backgrounds

Talent, Recruiting & Enablement

Recruit and hire engineers and engineering leaders who thrive in lean, agile, AI-augmented teams, and position HITT as a destination for top AI-native engineering talent
Design and deliver training and enablement programs that upskill HITT’s existing developers in AI-enabled development methods: from hands-on workshops and pairing to internal playbooks and certification
Build a deep talent bench and clear career paths within the engineering function to ensure succession for senior roles
Foster a culture of experimentation — fail fast and pivot — while managing risk responsibly

Delivery & Engineering Excellence

Bring structure, accountability, and delivery discipline to the software engineering function, balancing execution (≈60%) with innovation (≈40%)
Implement lean, agile delivery practices built on small batches, rapid iteration, continuous integration and deployment, and measurable outcomes
Engineer security, quality, and compliance into every product, in alignment with HITT’s zero trust cybersecurity strategy and NIST-aligned frameworks
Define engineering KPIs and provide ongoing transparency to the executive team on velocity, quality, adoption, and business value delivered
Leverage external partners strategically while avoiding over-reliance on consultants, building enduring in-house engineering capability

Executive Leadership & Cross-Functional Influence

Serve as a strategic advisor to executive and operational leaders on what modern, AI-enabled software development makes possible for the business
Partner with operations, virtual design and construction (VDC), preconstruction, and corporate functions to identify high-value opportunities for custom software, automation, and agentic workflows
Represent HITT’s engineering practice externally, in recruiting, industry forums, and the broader technology community, to attract talent and partnerships
Champion responsible AI use, model governance, and data stewardship across the software portfolio

Demonstrated success recruiting strong engineers and training existing developers in new tools, methods, and ways of working

Strong product sense and user empathy; experience delivering software for field-based or operational users (construction, engineering, manufacturing, logistics) is a plus
Executive-level communication and presentation skills; able to build conviction with C-suite audiences and translate deep technical topics for business leaders
Financial and vendor management acumen, with experience owning budgets and managing platform and tooling ecosystems

jobs.description:
About Chalk

Chalk is building the data platform that powers the future of machine learning applications. We tear down complexity, latency, and scale barriers that have traditionally constrained ML capabilities. Our platform combines Rust-speed performance with elegant tools that developers love to use. Leading companies depend on Chalk for everything from stopping fraudulent credit card swipes, verifying identities, and maximizing clean energy capture. We've recently raised a $50 million Series A, led by Felicis.

About the role

Working directly with our founders, you'll serve as the engineering site lead for our New York office. You'll start by directly managing individual contributor engineers and tech leads, and as we scale the team, you'll hire and develop engineering managers beneath you — building the leadership layer of our NYC organization from the ground up.
This is a rare opportunity to define the technical strategy, organizational structure, and engineering culture of a fast-growing AI infrastructure startup. You'll collaborate with brilliant folks, including Putnam and Advent of Code winners, former Jane Street quants, and Rust compiler contributors — all dedicated to bending the curve of what's possible in AI inference.

We're in the office 5 days a week. When unavoidable conflicts come up, we’re flexible. This is not a hybrid role.

What you will do

Serve as the engineering site lead for New York, with ownership of all NYC engineering
Directly manage engineers building Chalk's data platform, and hire and grow engineering managers as the site scales
Partner with the founding team to set technical strategy and shape our long-term product and platform roadmap
Design the organizational structure, hiring plan, and leadership pipeline for a rapidly growing engineering site
Establish engineering processes and operating rhythms that enable high velocity without sacrificing quality
Work directly with customers and executives to understand requirements and ensure Chalk's platform solves real-world ML challenges
Define and champion Chalk's engineering culture in New York — you'll set the bar for how we attract, develop, and retain top talent

What we're looking for

10+ years of engineering experience with 5+ years of engineering management
Experience managing managers, or a clear readiness to build and lead a multi-layer organization
Previous experience at an early-stage startup
Experience building production ML systems or data infrastructure
Strong programming skills and systems thinking — you understand how things work under the hood, and you stay close to the technology
Proven ability to lead through others: hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineers and engineering leaders
Executive-level communicator who can bridge technical, business, and customer contexts
Track record of delivering complex, high-stakes projects and scaling teams through rapid growth
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent

Bonus points

Experience as a site lead or founding leader of a new office or engineering hub
Experience with Rust or distributed systems
Experience with query planners or compilers
Experience implementing data infrastructure or PaaS-like software
Experience scaling engineering organizations from single-digit to multi-team in high-growth environments

About The Role

zerohash is hiring a VP of Engineering to lead our Trade organization, the team responsible for the trading technology that powers execution, liquidity, and market access across our platform. As zerohash scales, we're looking for a leader with deep, hands-on trading systems expertise, a proven track record building and scaling high-performing engineering organizations, and the presence to represent trade engineering at the leadership table. We believe the best engineering leaders are technologists first, with a product and business mindset, who seek outsized impact across the company.

Responsibilities

Own the technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for zerohash's trade organization, and align it with company strategy and the roadmaps of the transact, tokenize, and core teams
Build, lead, and scale a multi-team organization — hiring, developing, and retaining engineering managers, principal/staff engineers, and individual contributors as the team grows
Act as the executive owner of trading systems reliability, performance, and risk, including matching engines, order/execution infrastructure, market data, and FIX connectivity
Partner directly with the CTO, SVP Engineering, product leadership, and zerohash's other VP(s) of Engineering to set org-wide technical standards, priorities, and engineering culture
Represent engineering to company leadership and key partners/clients on matters related to trading technology
Recruit, coach, and develop engineering managers and senior technical talent; build durable career paths for the team
Partner with Compliance, Risk, and Legal to ensure trading systems meet the regulatory requirements relevant to zerohash's markets
Drive build-vs-buy, technical debt, and architecture trade-off decisions at an organizational level
Stay technically credible, engage deeply enough in system design and code-level decisions to earn the trust of senior engineers and maintain competency with the codebase and system architecture

Requirements

15+ years of software design and development experience, with deep hands-on background in backend and distributed systems
8+ years of engineering leadership experience, including managing managers and senior/principal/staff engineers
Proven track record building and scaling engineering organizations (30+ engineers) at a high-growth fintech, trading firm, exchange, or crypto company
Experience owning multi-team technical strategy and roadmap at a VP, Director, or Head of Engineering level
Prior exposure to fast-growth startups and comfort operating with ambiguity
Exceptional executive communication skills
Strong cross-functional partnership skills with Product, Compliance, Risk, and Legal
Cloud computing experience, with AWS highly desirable
BS or MS in Computer Science or Engineering, or equivalent experience
Strong bias toward serving your team and stakeholders, with a growth mindset

Domain Knowledge

Solid understanding of market structure, order types (Limit, Market, Stop, IOC, FOK), trade lifecycle, and common risks associated with electronic trading
Familiarity with regulatory requirements relevant to trading systems (e.g., MiFID II, Reg NMS)

Deep Understanding of Trading Systems

10+ years of hands-on experience developing, deploying, and maintaining high-performance, low-latency trading systems (e.g., central limit order books (CLOBs), matching engines, market data feeds)
Proven experience with FIX Protocol (4.2 and higher) and implementing highly reliable FIX Gateway solutions

High-Throughput / Low-Latency Development

Expertise in highly concurrent, multi-threaded, low-garbage/zero-garbage code in languages commonly used in finance such as C++, Rust, or Go
Demonstrable experience optimizing system performance to achieve single-digit microsecond latency

Core Financial Infrastructure

Strong background building and managing mission-critical backend systems such as trade booking systems, high-throughput accounting/ledger systems, and real-time credit/risk limit systems
Experience with distributed system design and messaging frameworks (e.g., Aeron, Kafka, ZeroMQ) for data distribution and persistence

Benefits

Healthcare Insurance: zerohash covers roughly 100% of employee premiums as well as a portion of spouse/children (U.S. only)
Vision & Dental Insurance (U.S. only)
Chance to earn equity
Maternity & Paternity leave (after 6 months)
WeWork All Access Membership
WFH Yearly Stipend
L&D Yearly Stipend (after 6 months)

About Zerohash

zerohash is the leading crypto and stablecoin infrastructure platform and the operating system for digital money, powering the next generation of financial services. Founded in 2017, zerohash enables banks, brokerages, fintechs, and payment companies to offer crypto trading, stablecoin payments, and tokenized assets without having to build or manage complex blockchain infrastructure on their own.

The zerohash platform supports three core pillars: Trade, Transact, and Tokenize. Through a single integration, customers can launch regulated crypto buy, sell, and custody services; enable 24/7 stablecoin-based funding, payouts, and settlement; and issue and manage tokenized assets with built-in compliance, risk controls, and reporting. By abstracting away technical, regulatory, and operational complexity, zerohash allows partners to treat digital assets as just another financial primitive: fast, programmable, and global.

zerohash is trusted by some of the world’s most recognized financial and consumer brands, including Interactive Brokers, Morgan Stanley, Stripe, Franklin Templeton, BlackRock, DraftKings, Gusto, Worldpay, Kalshi, One Pay, among others. Today, zerohash infrastructure supports millions of end users across brokerage, wealth, payments, and marketplace platforms globally.

The company is deeply regulated and compliance-first, operating across the U.S. and internationally with licenses and approvals that allow partners to enter crypto and stablecoins with confidence. zerohash has become a trusted partner for enterprises seeking to modernize financial products while meeting the highest standards for security, risk management, and regulatory oversight.

To date, zerohash has raised over $280 million in funding from a mix of leading venture firms and strategic investors, including Morgan Stanley, Interactive Brokers, SoFi, Point72 Ventures, Bain Capital Crypto, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and more.

zerohash has been featured in top-tier media outlets such as Bloomberg, CNBC, The Wall Street Journal, Financial Times, Reuters, Forbes, and CoinDesk, and its leadership team regularly contributes to global conversations on the future of payments, investing, and financial infrastructure.

At zerohash, we're building the infrastructure that makes digital money work securely, compliantly, and at global scale.

The zerohash Culture

All zerohash employees are guided by the following characteristics and core principles:

Independence/Ownership - An ability to work autonomously. Join zerohash, pitch ideas, and shape the work you do.
Passion - We are innovating quickly and challenging the status quo. We want you to think big, be creative and make a difference every day.
Collaborative - A good attitude and respect for others. We’re teammates, not co-workers. Everything we do is a shared success and equally a shared failure - we talk in terms of “we” not “me”.
Initiative - An ability and passion for learning and asking questions. We will champion you, challenge you and push you to achieve your best - and we expect you to do the same.
Empathy - An ability to listen, respect, and understand your co-workers, customers, and everyone you interact with no matter how different they are to you.
Adaptability - An ability to respond quickly. We are in a fast-paced industry and so we expect you to be creative when solving a new problem and comfortable under pressure.
Transparency - We believe that transparency is critical to empowering everyone to make the best decisions, both the company to its people and vice versa.
Integrity - Integrity creates trust. As both an organization collectively and as individuals, it is our most valuable asset.

jobs.description:
About BlueShift

At BlueShift, we are rebuilding mineral processing for a world that needs more critical minerals. Our mission is to make previously uneconomic resources viable using low-cost electrochemical processing, on-site reagent generation, modular systems, and data-driven process design. We are a team of engineers and operators advancing from integrated pilots to first commercial plants with industrial partners. Joining BlueShift means helping turn electrochemical science into reliable industrial systems that can be built, operated, and scaled.

About the role

We are a fast-growing startup commercializing next-generation electrochemical technology. We are seeking a visionary, hands-on Director of Engineering to join our executive leadership team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between breakthrough laboratory science and multi-megawatt commercial deployment. You will own the entire engineering lifecycle: from multi-cell electrochemical stack scale-up to BOP design, process engineering, and ultimate field commissioning. As a key strategic partner to the CEO and Board, you will ensure our systems are uncompromisingly safe, cost-optimized, and strictly built for manufacturability.

Responsibilities:

You will oversee the evolution of our electrochemical cell technology as it scales from lab-bench discovery, through pilot-scale testing, to robust multi-cell commercial stacks.
You will instill a strong culture of safety across all engineering operations by leading PHA and HAZOP reviews for all lab, pilot and commercial systems.
You will lead the process engineering team in designing, simulating, and building the BOP fluid, thermal, and electrical control systems.
You will ensure all engineering designs pivot early toward mass production, supply chain resilience, and automated assembly to minimize custom, non-scalable components.
You will act as the primary technical interface with EPC firms to manage large-scale system build and integration, scheduling, and delivery.
You will personally supervise and build the team responsible for the on-site deployment, testing, and commissioning of our first-of-a-kind commercial pilots, with extensive partner interface.
You will continually perform and refine rigorous TEA and system cost optimization models to drive down levelized costs.
You will serve as the primary engineering voice at the C-suite level by aligning technology roadmaps with business milestones, managing budgets, and presenting technical progress to investors and board members.
You will work alongside external legal counsel to build and strengthen our IP portfolio.

Required Qualifications & Skills

10 or more years of progressive engineering leadership experience, ideally within a high-growth startup or a fast-paced hardware development environment.
B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrochemical Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
Deep technical background in electrochemical systems like electrolyzers, fuel cells, or chlor-alkali.
Proven track record of taking a complex chemical or hardware technology out of the lab, through a pilot plant phase, and into successful commercial production.
Strong experience in process engineering and electrochemical system integration.
Familiarity with process simulation tools and techno-economic modeling practices.
You thrive in a startup environment, with rapid iterations and wearing multiple hats from high-level board decks to turning wrenches on a pilot skid.

What we offer

Competitive salary and equity ownership.
A high-impact role leading the engineering of first-of-a-kind electrochemical mineral processing systems.
Direct collaboration with the CEO, engineers, operators, customers, investors, and industrial partners.
Significant ownership over system architecture, engineering execution, team development, and the path from pilot to commercial scale.
A fast-moving, mission-driven environment with substantial autonomy and room to grow with the company.

We are committed to providing a workplace free from discrimination and harassment and to providing reasonable accommodations as required by law.

Head of Engineering / VP Engineering

One of our clients is building something genuinely different.

Rather than another warehouse robot or humanoid, they've developed a completely new class of climbing robot designed to inspect, maintain and eventually repair critical infrastructure around the world.

Their robots use a proprietary magnetic locomotion system to climb steel structures that existing robots simply can't access, enabling contact-based inspection, maintenance and manipulation on assets including:

Electrical transmission towers
Bridges
Pipelines
Industrial tanks
Shipbuilding infrastructure
Large-scale industrial facilities

With trillions of dollars being invested globally into upgrading energy infrastructure, renewable power and data centre capacity, demand already exists. Customers across North America and Europe are actively helping shape the product ahead of commercial deployment.
Following successful early funding, the business is now assembling its founding engineering leadership team as it prepares for a significant Seed round later this year.
This is where you come in.

The Opportunity

This isn't a traditional Head of Engineering position where you'll inherit a large organisation.

Today the engineering team is intentionally small, highly technical and moving incredibly fast. Your role will be to introduce the structure, engineering processes and technical leadership needed to scale without losing the agility that made the company successful in the first place.
Initially this is around 80% hands-on engineering leadership and execution, 20% strategy
, evolving into a broader organisational leadership role as the company grows.

You'll work directly alongside the founders, recruit key members of the engineering organisation and help build the foundations for what will become a much larger team over the next 12 to 24 months.

If you've always wanted to help build an engineering organisation from the ground up rather than inherit one, this is exactly that opportunity.

What You'll Be Doing
Lead and grow a multidisciplinary robotics engineering team.
Introduce engineering processes, systems and operational structure that enable rapid scaling.
Build a high-performance engineering culture centred around collaboration, ownership and technical excellence.
Work closely with Product and R&D to balance customer needs with engineering priorities.
Mentor engineering managers and senior individual contributors while remaining technically involved.
Help recruit the next generation of robotics engineers as the company scales following its Seed round.
Drive software, systems and hardware integration across a highly complex robotic platform.
Guide technical decisions across robotics software, controls, systems engineering and product development.
Help transition the company from advanced prototype development into commercial deployment.

What We're Looking For

We're far more interested in what you've built than where you've worked or studied.

You'll likely bring:
Experience leading engineering teams within robotics or autonomous systems.
A background building products in an early-stage startup environment.
Systems engineering experience with a strong appreciation for testing, validation and reliability.
Experience building engineering processes rather than simply operating within established ones.
Strong people leadership, including managing managers and growing technical organisations.
The ability to remain hands-on while leading a team.
Technical experience with C++, ROS2 and modern robotics software development.
Experience balancing engineering excellence with rapidly evolving product requirements.
A pragmatic approach to using AI to improve engineering productivity.
An interest in solving real-world physical problems rather than purely software challenges.

Bonus points if you've worked on:
Legged robotics
Outdoor autonomous systems
Critical infrastructure
Industrial robotics
Field robotics
Safety-critical robotic systems
Simulation and modelling

The Person

Success in this role is as much about mindset as technical ability.

You'll thrive if you:
Enjoy building teams from scratch.
Bring calm, experienced leadership to ambitious startup environments.
Challenge ideas constructively rather than simply saying "yes".
Are comfortable operating with ambiguity.
Believe in creating processes that accelerate engineering rather than slow it down.
Care more about building meaningful technology than chasing titles.
Lead with humility and treat people well.

Put simply: they're looking for an exceptional engineering leader with no ego
.

Why This Role?
Join at one of the earliest leadership stages.
Significant equity with genuine long-term upside.
Direct influence over company direction and engineering culture.
Opportunity to build and lead your own engineering organisation.
Clear progression towards a VP Engineering position as the company scales.
Solve problems that have never been solved before using robotics.
Help deploy robots that will transform how critical infrastructure is maintained worldwide.

If you're excited by building world-class engineering teams, solving genuinely difficult robotics challenges and helping create technology with global impact, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today or reach out for a confidential conversation.
